p.title: AI 기초: F0 modules stuck on loading; process modules and a duplicate listed
p.symptom: 문제와 능력 · 학습 방식 and the other F0 modules showed 불러오는 중입니다 forever; 주장·출처·기준일 and 사람의 검토 were listed as reader topics; CAPEX와 감가상각 appeared twice.
p.root_cause: The module view read only foundation-lessons.json, which has no F0 entries; the layer lists were rendered verbatim.
p.fix: industry-view renders FOUNDATION_STORIES first (covering F0), hides FOUNDATION_HIDDEN_MODULES and lists each module once; the dead FOUNDATION_LESSON_GUIDES table was removed from atlas.js.
p.violated_rule: Owner direction 2026-10-05: the learning hub reads as a professional research library — one contents·document·connections shell, no source/review/boundary chips on the reading surface, and story-form text of 3–5 lines per block that never stops at a one-line definition.
p.prevention: ci-atlas-contract-check foundation coverage reads the story module; ci-atlas-browser-check asserts unique modules, hidden process topics and F0 reading text.

changelog: **AI 기초 오류 (P1482):** 문제와 능력 등 F0 6개가 계속 "불러오는 중"으로 남던 문제를 고치고, 내부 검증 주제(주장·출처·기준일, 사람의 검토)는 목차에서 빼고 중복 항목을 정리했습니다.
